verdict.rationale: Data region and residency selection is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS AI app builder like v0, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents letting users choose where their data is stored. The closest items, Vercel-powered deployment infrastructure and third-party database integrations, are host-platform or adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
